## New Flow Submission

**Flow Name:**
**Description:**

### Checklist
- [ ] Flow exports and runs successfully in ArchonIDE
- [ ] flow.json is valid (nodes + edges present)
- [ ] index.json updated with metadata
- [ ] Description clearly explains what the flow does
- [ ] No hardcoded API keys or secrets in the flow

### How to Review
1. Install this flow in ArchonIDE from the PR branch
2. Test it with a real use case
3. Vote with a thumbs up reaction on this PR if it works well

**Merge threshold: 3+ thumbs up from community members.**
